title: The First Time In My Life

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eh……Ku-chan-senpai is still taking a break? 
Weren't we supposed to go back to normal training today——
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was the plan, but——
Yeah, that was the plan, but——

text_block_list.text:
Today, when I happened to run in to her during lunch, she still 
seemed like she was tired. I was the one that told her to take a break.

Today, when I happened to run in to her during lunch, she still 
seemed like she was tired. I was the one that told her to take a break.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right……well since the 『Takamatsunomiya Kinen』, 
she's raced three consecutive months. If she takes 
some time to slowly recover, it should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eh～, I guess so. ……Hm～～～……

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, right now Senpai's roommate is on a leave of absence right? 
Doesn't that mean she's alone in the dorms? ……Hmmmm～……

——This is today's menu. I've been adding a lot of stuff to prepare 
for the 『Oaks』 but……if you finish it, you can leave early, okay?

——This is today's menu. I've been adding a lot of stuff to prepare 
for the 『Oaks』 but……if you finish it, you can leave early, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……! I'll do it! I'll do it all! 
Don't underestimate a Genius!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And then, I'll go visit Ku-chan-senpai～～～!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh, hnnngh, hnnngh, Hnnghnununununu……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo, hoo, hoo, hoo, hoo……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Uuryaaaaaaaaaa————!
…………Alright~! Best time!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And so, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Okay, okay. You're done for today!
Okay, okay. You're done for today!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Got it! 'preciate it! 
See ya tomorrow～～～～!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Oh man～……to think she'd seriously be able to finish it all early. 
She really is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Kuuu～～～ As usual, for someone blessed with talent……!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose that's true. 
……On the other hand, maybe something's begun to grow within her?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew————……weird.
Getting easier to get tired……?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Seeeeeenpaiiiii—————!
Hey hey hey hey————☆

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah? P-Pandora-san……? 
Huh, what about training?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Done in an instant♪ So I came to visit! Now you won't be lonely, 
right? Lovely don't you think? Feelin' better already aren't you～?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……Anyways. No, seriously……Ku-chan-senpai, are you okay? 
That was the first time you were off the boards right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's just that, well～……before your race, 
it felt like you were doing all kinds of things for me～……?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Ah, don't worry about that! It's not Pandora-san's fault, 
you know? The race……yeah, I wasn't really able to focus at the start.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, since Pandora-san was together with me——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
…………Nnaaaa～! I'm so frustrated! 
I showed you something uncool～.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, that's not true! 
I never thought that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Because……because I saw it! I watched Senpai! 
Working hard everyday! Really～ hard……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Fufu. Thank you, Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But, I still wanted to show you. 
Show you……even just a little, and hopefully encourage you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Encourage……?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ——For the 『Oaks』.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Instead of the 『Oaks』, I chose the 『NHK Mile C』. 
I don't regret it though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But……I did admire the Triple Tiara stage. 
Winning the 『Oaks』 really was my dream at one point.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's why……well, maybe it's just a little selfish of me, but! 
We've been working so hard together, so for Pandora-san's 『Oaks』——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to give it everything I had to cheer you on! 
……Even though I totally messed up, ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Ku-chan……senpai————

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (……Will they sparkle again?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (If I win…… If I can just win the 『Oaks』……)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Senpai's eyes…… Will they shine bright again——?)
(The next day, after training. Surprisingly, Fusaichi Pandora had stayed behind——and was now slowly walking over to me.)
(The next day, after training. Surprisingly, Fusaichi Pandora had stayed behind——and was now slowly walking over to me.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: …………Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: To win the 『Oaks』……what else do I need to do?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My, my. ……The girl who was just boasting 『I'm a genius!』 and 『Winning is a given!』 is actually asking for advice?
——Of course! But there's still plenty to be done before then. We're doing this 『for real』, Fusaichi Pandora!
——Of course! But there's still plenty to be done before then. We're doing this 『for real』, Fusaichi Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Yeah! Okay, let's do it!
First off, I'm sure you've heard this plenty of times, but your raw talent…… Your sheer potential is unbelievable. We need to draw out every last drop of it.
First off, I'm sure you've heard this plenty of times, but your raw talent…… Your sheer potential is unbelievable. We need to draw out every last drop of it.
On the flip side, the only reason you've lost up until now is because you weren't 『giving it your all』. The most crucial part——is to 『run all the way through to the finish』!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Tenacity, huh～? Guts and grit～…… So mental strength is the key?

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Mental grit, fighting spirit…… Then it's definitely gotta be *that*!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ——Let me make this clear right now. I am nowhere near as soft on people as Kraft-san is.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Uwaah～…… R-Roger that! Bring it on!
Let's focus our training on parallel runs with Kraft! Keep a sharp eye on your stamina pacing and exactly when to launch your spurt.
Let's focus our training on parallel runs with Kraft! Keep a sharp eye on your stamina pacing and exactly when to launch your spurt.
Especially when dealing with your biggest rival in the 『Oaks』, Kawakami Princess. Just like Kraft, she's a powerhouse with a relentless, sustained spurt.
choice_data_list: Surpassing that will be the true battle!

text_block_list.text: Especially when dealing with your biggest rival in the 『Oaks』, Kawakami Princess. Just like Kraft, she's a powerhouse with a relentless, sustained spurt.
choice_data_list: Surpassing that will be the true battle!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hii~ Haaa~…… R-Rogeeeeerrrr———!
——Alright, that wraps up today's review session. I was planning to go over how our rivals might move during Pandora's 『Oaks』, but……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san, please forgive her! Pandora-san looks like she's reached her absolute limit……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Funyaa～～～…… Howehehe……
choice_data_list: Kraft, please take her back to the dorms
Kraft, please take her back to the dorms

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Got it……! Pandora-san, over here! Lean on my shoulder, just like that! Up we go～ One-two～……!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Good grief…… It really does feel like 『the hardest she's ever worked in her entire life』, doesn't it?
Her first true longing. Her first genuine effort. Day by day, that hard work steadily piled up——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Phew～～～………… Alright! I can do this. ……Yeah, I've got this!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ku-chan-senpai. ——I'm gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Just watch me. ……I'm definitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: And now, today's main event, the 『Oaks』, is about to begin! Among all the contenders, the spotlight falls squarely on the currently undefeated——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh. ……Kawakami-senpai～, yoo-hoo～. Getting all this attention for your first G1 race, aren't you nervous at all?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Pandora-san! Fufuu, thank you for your concern. ……However, I am in absolute peak condition!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Because today, I have come to claim it! My very own—Princess Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A princess must be noble, captivating, and powerful! I shall blow each and every one of you away!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Now you've gone and said it——!
